expected: the first product becomes Slip Joint Pliers (cheapest at $9.17)
the number of product cards remains 9

meta.dataFix: Expected first-product names verified against the live catalogue 2026-08-22. The capture only ever saw the UNSORTED first page, so the planner inferred what sorting would put first from that subset and got both wrong: name,desc is "Wood Saw" (not "Thor Hammer") and price,asc is "Washers" (not "Slip Joint Pliers"). The capture sets a ceiling on expected VALUES, not only on selectors. Known limitation: naming the first product couples these tests to the demo dataset; asserting that the rendered names are in sorted order would be stronger and needs a plan action that does not exist yet.
